To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1. Transformational leadership is a prerequisite for instructional leadership; 2. The presence of both transformational and instructional
transformational leadership alone has a positive but small influence on school performance; instructional leadership alone has no influence on school performance.
transformational leadership, shared instructional leadership, and the integration of the two are positively related to school performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of school leadership and the impact of leadership relations on the quality of instruction and the achievement of students in restructured schools.
the quality of school leadership and its influence on the quality of school performance.
the leadership of school principals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the more principals engage in transformational leadership, the more teachers engage in shared instructional leadership, and the more teachers share in instructional leadership the higher the level of school performance.
the integration of transformational and instructional leadership is the most promising approach for enhancing school performance.
the more principals are perceived by their teachers to be transformational leaders who are also engaged in instructional leadership, the more likely their schools are to be high performing schools.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
instructional leadership is a necessary and sufficient condition for the quality of pedagogy, and that instructional leadership is contingent on transformational leadership.
transformational and instructional leadership are not mutually exclusive.
the more a principal engages teachers in the process of improving the quality of teaching, and the more teachers are committed to the school, the better the school performs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the leadership of schools matters, but not just any leadership. It is the leadership that is transformational and
principals can make a difference in the quality of instruction in schools and, ultimately, in student performance.
instructional leadership is a powerful force that can be harnessed to improve the quality of teaching.
